entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: Red-aligned human mountain barbarians and sorcerers of the Oxidda Chain on Mirrodin, preeminent blacksmiths.

entities.name: Oxidda Chain
entities.description: Mountain range home of the Vulshok.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: New Vulshok leader who restored their peace.

entities.name: Krark Clan
entities.description: Goblins with amiable relations with the Vulshok.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: Human tribe with heated relations with the Vulshok.

entities.name: Spear
entities.description: Highland forge tribe of magic and piercing weapons.

entities.name: Blade
entities.description: Highland forge tribe of edged weapons and fire magic.

entities.name: Hammer
entities.description: Lowland forge tribe of blunt arms and earth magic.

entities.name: Helm
entities.description: Lowland tribe producing armor and leaders.

entities.name: Anvil
entities.description: Tribe of the deep valleys who refine metals.

events.summary: Phyrexian corruption upsets the balance of the six forge tribes, causing civil war.
events.quote: Civil war broke up once more among the barbarians

events.summary: Koth restores the Vulshok's fragile peace.
events.quote: only the act of the new Vulshok leader, Koth could restore their fragile peace.

events.summary: The Phyrexian destruction of Mirran culture leaves the Vulshok functionally extinct.
events.quote: The Vulshok were rendered functionally extinct from the Phyrexian destruction of Mirran culture

relations.quote: more or less amiable relations with the goblins of the Krark Clan
